newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed after UK Conservatives defeat.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed after UK Conservatives defeat.

text.p: UK shares opened mixed to lower on Friday, depressed by the weak finish in New York and with little scheduled corporate or economic news to buck sentiment, dealers said.
The Conservatives crushing defeat in the Wirral South by-election did little to help cheer sentiment.
"The market was expecting the worst in the by-election, and that is what we got," one said.
"It's going to be a very bland day," said one dealer. "It will be a day of consolidation," another added.

The FTSE 100 index was off 10.2 points at 4,329.0 by 0843 GMT. Losers were in a three-to-one majority. "On any recent weakness we've seen plenty of buying interest by institutions, so today will be no disaster, but I expect it will be very quiet," another dealer said.
